memory: I have quantified blade oscillation vs neoprene thickness. Key points: baseline peak 0.0180 mm; 1.0 mm reduces to 0.0061 mm; linear damping holds 0–1.25 mm (slope −0.0112 mm/mm); plateau after ~1.5 mm. τ0 = 0.0340±0.0028 s unchanged through 2.0 mm, but increases at ≥2.25 mm. Correction: neoprene does not universally leave τ0 unchanged — thickness-dependent shift begins ≈2.2 mm. Current position: prefer 1.0–1.5 mm pads for damping without altering onset timing.
openQuestion: Is the τ0 shift at ≥2.25 mm caused by static preload or dynamic compression? Vary static preload on a 2.25 mm pad in 0.1 N steps and re-measure τ0.
